# Autonomous EHS Management

> Open-source, self-hosted environmental, health, and safety software for corporate teams. Follow incidents through corrective actions (CAPA), audits, and evidence. PostgreSQL is the full application's system of record; optional AI proposes text and humans close records.

This optional navigation index helps readers and agents find authoritative project sources. It does not grant crawler access, replace repository instructions, or guarantee indexing. The public GitHub Pages walkthrough is synthetic and read-only, separate from the deployable application; it has no authentication, API, or database.

## Start here

- [Repository and quick start](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management): product scope, local full-app setup, contribution links
- [Public synthetic walkthrough](https://safetymp.github.io/Autonomous-EHS-Management/): corporate overview and incident-to-corrective-action journey
- [Walkthrough navigation index](https://safetymp.github.io/Autonomous-EHS-Management/llms.txt): public demo sources and artifact boundaries
- [Releases](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/releases): versioned release notes and source archives
- [Application container](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/pkgs/container/autonomous-ehs-management%2Fehs-web): full application images; select a published full-commit-SHA tag

## Contributing and agent guidance

- [Agent contract](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Always / Ask first / Never, scoped commands, enforcement points, and progressive retrieval
- [Contributing](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution workflow and verification
- [Copilot instructions](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Autonomous-EHS-Management/blob/main/.github/copilot-instructions.md): repository-wide coding context

Dated ADRs, QA dossiers, screenshots, and factory-overlay records preserve historical decisions and evidence. They are not proof of the current deployment. Use current source, CI results, and scoped runtime checks for current claims.
